title: Village chat message
description: One row of the SurrealDB `message` table (D16, contracts 1.1.0): the village group chat with Village as a participant. Members write only kind=chat (POST /villages/{id}/messages); `village` posts are created by core from ledger rows (incident, proposal, receipt, nudge) or by the builder's ask() (answer) and always carry at least one ref; `system` posts are lifecycle lines ('Ana invited everyone', 'Marco joined'). Append-only: a correction is a new message, never an edit. Chat rows are NOT ledger events; Village posts cite ledger rows by id in refs[]. Fanned out as WS `chat` frames to every member socket whose view is not elder, plus control; bound as chat:village (last 50). Never on the safety path.

text.description: Plain words in the village's family language (the coordinator's lang). Village/system posts may add text_i18n.

text_i18n.description: Optional localized copies of text for village/system posts.

mention.description: Member posts: 'village' when the text addresses @Village (routed to ask-why or a change request); null otherwise.

reply_to.description: The message this one answers (kind answer replies to the @Village message).

refs.description: Source chips. Village posts: ≥ 1. proposal posts carry {kind: proposal}; receipt posts carry {kind: release}; incident posts carry the money_request event and/or {kind: incident}.

routed.description: Member @Village posts only: how core routed the mention (also returned by POST /villages/{id}/messages).

source.description: app: ref = member_id or ws req_id · system: ref = gate | evolve | release | builder | scheduler · call: a message created from a call (ref = conversation_id).

author.description: A member id, or Village itself, or the system (lifecycle lines).

examples.author: village
examples.text: Someone called Mamá as Marco, asking for $2,000. I asked Marco; he said it wasn’t him. I told her not to send money. Nothing was sent.

text_i18n.en: Someone called Mamá as Marco, asking for $2,000. I asked Marco; he said it wasn’t him. I told her not to send money. Nothing was sent.
text_i18n.es: Alguien llamó a Mamá diciendo ser Marco y pidió $2,000. Le pregunté a Marco; dijo que no fue él. Le dije a ella que no mande dinero. No se envió nada.

examples.author: m_ana
examples.text: Approved. @Village why Marco and not Lucía?

examples.author: village
examples.text: The caller claimed to be Marco, so I checked with Marco. Lucía isn’t set up for calls (her choice at joining).
